dialogues.speaker: Stone Gate Bulletin Board
dialogues.text: This is the Stone Gate Bulletin Board. You can find notices and messages from passersby posted here.

dialogues.speaker: Message
dialogues.text: "'The gleaming blade reveals scarlet rain in forest shadows; I only hope that many-a-drink may drown my sorrows.' — A swordsman with no understanding of poetic verse. Feedback welcome."

dialogues.speaker: Another Note
dialogues.text: "In my humble opinion... the second line makes absolutely no sense!"
